source: Moki from Nomgar Clash (Moku-approved IP): Tools/rea-lab/data/nomgar/glb/Moki.glb (exported from the game's Unity data by Tools/rea-lab/scripts/unity_to_glb.py; 3,223 tris, 23 bones, clips Idle / Run / Damage / Die / Skill / Attack1 / Attack2). Copied unchanged (1,525,536 bytes = 1.45 MiB, under the 1.5 MB WebP line like Golem_Child).
note: No jump clip in the GLB: jump / fall play the idle clip with the code stretch / squash on top (clipFallback + ProceduralMotion), slide = idle clip + code squash/lean, land = code squash. Face meshes (Face_* materials, unlit decals) get no ink. Never in an enemy roster.
